dedupe_keys.name: solarmagix north macedonia multi station pv and weather telemetry

description: SolarMagix integrates photovoltaic production and weather telemetry from multiple stations and inverter manufacturers in North Macedonia. The Data in Brief article and current Mendeley version 2 describe a cleaned station-level view of 13,193 rows and an inverter-level view of 88,285 rows. The public CC BY 4.0 release lists thirteen CSV files covering device metadata, production, weather joins, source mappings and canonical inverter states. The producer also exposes raw or less aggregated production tables to make alignment choices visible. Coverage is a set of contributing stations, not all national PV systems, and timestamp cleaning or manufacturer-specific state mapping may affect anomaly interpretation. These are limitations for training a failure predictor or transferring one inverter state code to another site. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating PV yield, weather sensitivity or fault-detection components in electricity simulations. data-ch-rpv300-rooftop-pv-profiles-switzerland is a related PV dataset from a different country; no schema harmonisation was tested. No telemetry was downloaded.
